title: Friendship: this week's gifts to Finn are given
about: QA round. Spring 11 (week 2), 15:30 by the woods lake facing Finn, two gifts given to him this week (days 8 and 10), a trout (loved) in the bag. Gift is greyed and the note says "Again next week." (pt-BR: "Semana que vem."). On day 15 it opens again. The same present twice in 14 days is worth half ("Trout again? Thanks.").
